about_the_game:
A Story Across the Multiverse

It all began with a lost signal in space.

Your ship, damaged after passing through an unknown anomaly, crashes on a tropical island that doesn’t appear on any star map. Among palm trees, forgotten ruins, and mysterious technology, you soon discover the truth: you’ve landed on Lost World, a convergence point between worlds… and the first link in something far greater.

This place is only the gateway to the Space HUB, an ancient interdimensional nexus capable of connecting entire realities. For centuries, the Space HUB has remained sealed, fragmented into artifacts known as Loops, scattered across the multiverse. Without them, the portals stay closed… and worlds remain isolated.

The Legend of the Golden Loop

Among all the Loops, one is spoken of in legend: the Golden Loop. It is said that whoever finds it will not only restore balance to the multiverse, but also uncover the true origin of the connected worlds… and the reason they began to collapse.

Your mission is clear: explore every world, overcome its trials, and recover the lost Loops. But nothing will be easy. Each reality holds its own secrets, rules, and dangers. Ancient civilizations, abandoned futuristic stations, and impossible landscapes will test your wit, reflexes, and curiosity.

Worlds Full of Secrets

eWorlds is a classic collectathon adventure at heart, infused with mystery and discovery. Paths are not always visible—hidden platforms, alternate routes, and secret areas reveal themselves only to those willing to explore beyond the obvious.

Sometimes you’ll race against the clock in intense time trials. Other times, you’ll slow down to observe your surroundings, listening to what each world has to say… because every environment has its own story waiting to be uncovered.

Otherworldly Tools

Progress requires more than skill alone. Throughout your journey, you’ll obtain ancient Power-Ups that transform the way you play:

  • The Hammer, capable of breaking seemingly unmovable barriers.

  • The Umbrella, allowing you to glide and defy gravity.

  • The Grapple, essential for crossing dangerous gaps and treacherous terrain.

These aren’t simple upgrades—they’re the key to accessing new areas, uncovering secrets, and mastering each world.

An Adventure Meant to Be Shared

The multiverse was never meant to be explored alone. In co-op mode, you and your friends can join forces, combine abilities, and face the toughest challenges together. Some secrets only reveal themselves when more than one explorer dares to take the risk.

Customize your journey

As you explore, you’ll collect coins scattered across every world. Spend them in the Space HUB shop to unlock a variety of skins and customize your character. Mix and match to create a unique look that reflects your style as you traverse unknown realities.

The multiverse awaits… will you overcome its dangers and find the legendary Golden Loop?

Important note:

We will only be providing support in English and Spanish, but we have automatically translated the game into other languages to enhance the experience for everyone (Italian, French, German, Portuguese, Polish, Russian, Korean, Chinese, Traditional Chinese and Japanese). However, please keep in mind that this is not a professional translation and may contain errors.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10/11 de 64 bits
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 fourth generation or equivalent
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 960 o AMD Radeon R9 280
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 3 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Keyboard and Mouse

Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 de 64 bits
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 sixth generation or equivalent
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060 o AMD Radeon RX 580
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Gamepad, Headphones, Keyboard and Mouse

short_description: After an accident, your ship crashes on an unknown island, a convergence point between worlds. Explore impossible landscapes, overcome traps and puzzles, recover the lost Loops, and see if you can find the legendary Golden Loop in this 3D platforming narrative adventure.
supported_languages: English, Spanish - Spain, French, Italian, German, Japanese, Korean, Polish, Portuguese - Brazil, Russian, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese
